# Bocchi the Sulfur Cube!

Bocchi the Sulfur Cube is a cute resource pack that replaces the Sulfur Cube with a shy, pink  slime from an anime called **_Bocchi the Rock!_**

Inspired by Bocchi’s iconic anxious energy, this pack turns the sulfur cube into a nervous little slime that would rather not be noticed!.

![Bocchi the Sulfur Cube - Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c014da87ec21e08c19b220039e901098a71c3fb8.png)

### Features
- Replaces Sulfur Cube with a pink Bocchi slime(Including the name!)
- Cute & anxious expression
- Clean pixel-art style
- Lightweight & vanilla-friendly
- Includes the Spawn-eggs and also bucket
